target_distribution.note: Aggregated across all inspected years; see reports/target_distribution.json for the validated, label-mapped version.

model_features_that_need_a_missing_sourc.pedestrian_crossing_human_control: column absent from the downloaded files -> feature skipped
model_features_that_need_a_missing_sourc.pedestrian_crossing_physical_facilities: column absent from the downloaded files -> feature skipped

excluded_columns_present_in_files.collision_index: IDENTIFIER: no predictive meaning; kept only to de-duplicate and verify the split.
excluded_columns_present_in_files.collision_year: Excluded to avoid memorising year-level drift (reporting changes, COVID-19 2020); kept only for analytics and temporal splitting.
excluded_columns_present_in_files.date: Raw date replaced by engineered month / weekday / season.
excluded_columns_present_in_files.day_of_week: Raw STATS19 code (1=Sunday) replaced by engineered weekday / is_weekend.
excluded_columns_present_in_files.did_police_officer_attend_scene_of_accid: POST-EVENT: attendance is a response to the collision and is more likely for severe collisions, so it encodes the outcome.
excluded_columns_present_in_files.latitude: HIGH-CARDINALITY continuous geography. Not used as a model feature (location memorisation, weak generalisation); rounded copy kept for the historical map and grid aggregation only.
excluded_columns_present_in_files.number_of_casualties: LEAKAGE: only known after the outcome, and mechanically linked to severity (a fatal collision has at least one casualty; more casualties -> more likely severe).
excluded_columns_present_in_files.police_force: Administrative area with force-specific reporting practice; would let the model learn reporting differences rather than collision circumstances. (Move to ALLOWED_FEATURES to test it.)
excluded_columns_present_in_files.second_road_class: Structurally missing away from junctions and largely redundant with junction_detail.
excluded_columns_present_in_files.time: Raw time replaced by engineered hour and derived flags.
